parties: Patel Greentech Private Limited; Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL); contractors (EPC & O&M, unnamed)
headline: Trilegal advised Patel Greentech on tender process for 700 MW solar project in Gujarat
sum: Trilegal structured and drafted the tender documents for Patel Greentech's 700 MW utility-scale solar project in Gujarat, covering land aggregation, EPC, O&M contracting and risk allocation, with electricity supply to GUVNL. The mandate encompasses end-to-end tender design, bidder qualification frameworks and downstream contracting structure.
implication: Risk allocation across land, design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, statutory approvals and grid connectivity in utility-scale solar EPC tenders is now a precedent area for structuring independent power producer platforms in India's renewable energy sector.
detail: Patel Greentech engaged Trilegal to structure a comprehensive tender for a 700 MW solar project proposed for supply to Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL), an ISTS-connected facility forming part of the company's emerging IPP platform. Trilegal's Energy & Infrastructure team led by Neeraj Menon and Gautam Chabra, and Dispute Resolution team led by Shankh Sengupta and Abhishek Kumar, advised on tender drafting, NIT formulation, bid instructions, bidder qualification, EPC and O&M term sheets, and risk allocation across land aggregation, design, engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, statutory approvals, grid connectivity and O&M obligations. The structure includes separate packages for land aggregation, EPC and O&M services, with documented risk corridors across each phase.

structure.novel: Tri-partite tender structure separating land aggregation, EPC and O&M services into distinct bidder packages with documented inter-package risk corridors and cross-package performance dependencies; precedent for modular IPP platform development in Indian utility-scale solar.
